statement: All 15 large AXPY/STREAM/REDUCTION cells choose RTX 3090 for runtime and RTX 5060 Ti for energy.
Always 3090 median energy regret 72.382%; always 5060 Ti median runtime regret 110.564%.
Maximum CPU threads have median energy regret 38.517%.
Strict Pareto fronts average 1.549 configurations per 18-point cell.
EDP and runtime point winners agree in 48/51 cells.
